name: Krossovka
tagline: Authentic sneakers, Saturday drops and a clean that makes a pair look new

listing.description: A site for a sneaker store, streetwear shop or sports boutique. A countdown to the next drop, a giant pair on the first screen, release cards with sizes and a lookbook grid.

seo.title: Krossovka — authentic sneakers and drops in Tashkent
seo.description: Authentic Nike, New Balance, adidas and Asics with legit checks. Drops every Saturday at 10:00, raffles on Telegram, sneaker cleaning and restoration.
seo.answer: Krossovka is an authentic sneaker store in Magic City (5 Shakhrisabz St, Tashkent), open from 10:00 to 22:00. Every pair is legit-checked, new releases drop on Saturdays at 10:00 and rare pairs are raffled on Telegram. Prices start at 990,000 UZS, a sneaker clean costs 120,000 UZS, and we deliver across Uzbekistan.

sections.title: Next drop
sections.subtitle: A new release every Saturday at 10:00. Authentic pairs only, legit-checked, and rare ones go through a Telegram raffle so resellers miss out.

sections.label: The store
sections.title: No fakes, no resellers
sections.text: We started in 2019 with one shelf and an Instagram page; today it is a store in Magic City with hundreds of pairs on the wall. Every pair is checked by its stitching, labels and code, and rare releases sell by raffle, one pair per person. Want old sneakers looking fresh? We have our own cleaning workshop.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.title: Cleaning and restoration
sections.intro: Suede, nubuck, leather and textile. Turnaround is 2 to 5 days.

items.text: Enter with your size by Friday — one account, one entry.

items.text: Saturday at 10:00 we pick winners at random, live on stream.

items.title: Pick-up
items.text: You have 48 hours to collect in store or book delivery.

items.quote: Won the 1906R raffle on my first try — no reseller mark-up.

items.quote: Sent my old suede Gazelles for a re-dye and they came back looking boxfresh.
items.author: Sabina

items.quote: They brought my Salomons to order in nine days, with the receipt and box.

items.a: We buy only from official distributors and vetted buyers and check every pair by stitching, labels, code and box. If in doubt, we do not sell it.
Yes, within 14 days if the pair is unworn and you have the box.
Yes, across Uzbekistan in 1–3 days, pay on delivery or online.
A basic clean is 120,000 UZS, sole whitening 180,000 UZS and a suede re-dye 250,000 UZS.
